The '''Hoth's Brand system''',<ref name="Kyle Katarn's Tale">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale5|text=Light and Dark: Kyle Katarn's Tale, Mission 5|int=Kyle Katarn's Tale}}</ref> also known as the '''Ruusan system''', contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. It was located in the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> Most of the bodies in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] were named after [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who fought in the [[Ruusan campaign|Battle of Ruusan]].
